summary: Shen Feizhi confronts Lin Sui at a gala regarding his withdrawal of funding from W.N. and his betrayal of his adoptive parents, the late Professor Lin and Professor Gu. It is revealed that the Shen family is sabotaging W.N. and that Lin Sui may have been involved in the slander that led to the deaths of Gu Suizhou's parents. Shen Feizhi plans to overturn the case against Gu Suizhou's parents and intends to confront Elder Master Shen. Gu Suizhou, who is revealed to be applying to the Federation Research Institute, accompanies Shen Feizhi to the Shen family cemetery, where he displays a surprising fear of the supernatural.
